app_context: Italian Insurance SaaS & Policy Management Platform (PolizzaHub / AssicuraFlow)

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-medium text-slate-500

layout_and_spacing.card_radius: rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 bg-white shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200
layout_and_spacing.header_style: sticky top-0 z-40 w-full bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200

components_and_views.navigation: Sidebar Navigation with links to Dashboard, Polizze (Policies), Estrazione AI (AI Extract), Scadenziario (Deadline Agenda), Modelli PDF (PDF Field Placement), Firma YouSign (YouSign OTP Sign).
components_and_views.dashboard_view: Summary KPI cards (Totale Polizze, In Scadenza, Premio Totale, In Attesa di Firma), upcoming deadlines feed, policy distribution by Ramo (RCA, Incendio, Infortuni, Vita), quick actions.
components_and_views.policy_crud_form: Comprehensive Italian insurance form divided into logical sections: Anagrafica (Contraente & Proprietario), Dati Polizza (Numero, Compagnia, Agenzia, Tipo, Ramo), Date & Scadenze (Data effetto, Data scadenza, Frazionamento: Annuale/Semestrale), Dettaglio Premi (Premio Netto/Lordo Annuale e Semestrale), Specifiche RCA (Data immatricolazione, Data voltura).
components_and_views.ai_document_extraction: PDF/JPEG file dropzone, instant extraction progress, side-by-side verification view comparing extracted data tags with source document preview, one-click save or edit.
components_and_views.scadenziario_view: Calendar/List view filtered by Date Range (Da - A), status pills (Scaduta, In Scadenza, Attiva), quick action to notify client or renew policy.
components_and_views.pdf_template_editor: Interactive visual canvas to upload custom PDF, drag & drop or click-to-place policy fields onto exact X/Y coordinates, preview filled document, download or send for signature.
components_and_views.yousign_flow: Send document for signature via YouSign API integration simulation, OTP verification step, signer phone number/email fields, status tracker (Bozza, Inviato, Firmato).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.general: Maintain clean Italian business terminology (Contraente, Proprietario, Frazionamento Semestrale/Annuale, Premio Netto, Premio Lordo, Data Voltura, Compagnia di Emissione, Agenzia).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.accessibility: Ensure high text contrast against pure white cards and light slate backgrounds. Ensure clear hover/focus states with visible focus rings.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.responsiveness: Full mobile-to-desktop fluid design with collapsable sidebar menu and scrollable data tables.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.mocking: Provide interactive realistic Italian dummy data for policies, companies (Generali, UnipolSai, Allianz, AXA, Reale Mutua), and clients.
